title: Rust DAO authority accepts and originates noncanonical link-local identity aliases
description: Security review P1. spec/05-routing.md requires the DAO origin IPv6 address to be the signer's full primary 02xx address preserved end to end. SignatureVerifiedDao::verify_signature in rust/lichen-rpl/src/verify.rs checks only origin[8..] against iid_from_pubkey; provisioning validate_origin does the same. The new RplStack control-address split then provisions/signs/transmits DAO using canonical_link_local in provisioning.rs and transmit.rs. Thus arbitrary upper 64-bit aliases sharing the IID are signature-valid, and production emits fe80:: origins. Enforce exact ygg_addr_from_pubkey equality for DAO origin/target authority, retain link-local only for hop control where the signed origin transcript remains primary 02xx, and add rejection plus production-origin vectors.
